title: Potassium Water
description: Pure Potassium + water = BOOM! Explosive throwables in Minecraft!
body: _This image has an affiliate link, aka I can get a commission (MONEY for me at no expense to you) if you purchase through this link. So if you wanna support me, and get a neat little server for Minecraft, click the image!_ # Potassium Water A semi-scientifically inaccurate mod revolving around the concept that pure potassium explodes when in contact with water. Adds an item called "Potassium Water", when thrown it explodes. It can be found in Igloos, Ancient Cities, Jungle Temple, and End City Treasure chests. ## Questions/Suggestions/Problems Make an [issue](https://github.com/friedegg796/Potassium-Water/issues), I'll check it inshaAllah. ### How do I install... On [Github](https://github.com/friedegg796/Potassium-Water), you have to install zip, unzip it, open your terminal, cd into it, and then run ./gradlew build (Requires Java), then look for the jar file in build/libs of the unzipped folder (Unreleased versions). Or go to the [releases](https://github.com/friedegg796/Potassium-Water/releases), pick the release you want, and install the jar file ### Could I put your Mod into MY modpack/Use it in my video?
